papers.title: RESEARCH ON LEARNING INTRODUCTORY BIOMECHANICSIMECHANICS
papers.abstract: Most students find mechanics and biomechanics concepts munterintuitive and difficult, and therefore have a negative perception of the subject. This paper reviews the research on learning biomechanical concepts, noting recent advances in standardized tests, identifying factors associated with learning, and strategies to increase learning. Active learning pedagogies typically double learning of mechanics and biomechanics concepts compared to traditional lecturellab instruction. The Scholarship of Teachlng and Learnlng (SoTL) literature in many sclences clearly supports use of active learning strategies, focusing on student engagement through personal and career interests, and emphasis on qualitative understanding of concepts. Biomechanics faculty can advance student interest in the field by continued faculty engagement and support of SoTL research.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文是关于生物力学教学方法的综述，与有限元代理建模或植入物设计无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a pedagogical review on teaching biomechanics, with no computational modeling, surrogate methods, uncertainty quantification, or implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 学生认为生物力学概念难学且负面，需改进教学。
summary_zh.method: 综述标准化测试、学习因素和主动学习策略。
summary_zh.result: 主动学习比传统教学效果翻倍。
summary_zh.validation: 引用SoTL文献支持，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Students find biomechanics concepts unintuitive and difficult, necessitating improved pedagogical approaches.
summary_en.method: This review synthesizes research on standardized tests, factors influencing learning, and active learning strategies in biomechanics.
summary_en.result: Active learning pedagogies approximately double learning outcomes compared to traditional lecture/lab instruction.
summary_en.validation: The paper relies on existing Scholarship of Teaching and Learning literature without presenting new experimental validation.

papers.title: TEACHING INTRODUCTORY AND ADVANCED BtOMECHANICS IN GERMANY AND THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA
papers.abstract: This paper will review differences and similarities of teaching biomechanics in Germany and the United States. Data of typical biomechanics course offerings in exercise sciencelsports science programs for both countries will be presented. Furthermore, the structure of course offerings will be discussed with respect to lecture/lab and active learning opportunities.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文讨论的是生物力学教学课程设置，与有限元代理模型或植入物设计无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is about biomechanics education and curriculum comparison, not about surrogate modeling, FEA, or any computational method for implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较德国和美国生物力学教学的差异与相似性。
summary_zh.method: 分析运动科学项目中典型生物力学课程的数据和结构。
summary_zh.result: 展示了两国课程设置的异同及主动学习机会。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，基于课程数据描述。

summary_en.motivation: This paper aims to compare and contrast biomechanics teaching approaches in Germany and the United States.
summary_en.method: It analyzes typical biomechanics course offerings in exercise science/sports science programs from both countries.
summary_en.result: Differences and similarities in course structure, lecture/lab balance, and active learning opportunities are presented.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the study is based on descriptive curriculum data.
